chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who gave another man funds for a hajj so that he might perform it on his behalf from Kufa, but he performed it on his behalf from Basra, he عليه السلام said: “There is no harm. If he completed all of his rites, then his hajj has been completed.”

key_terms.تَمَّ حَجُّهُ: his hajj is complete and valid
key_terms.حَجَّةً: funds or provision given for performing hajj
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مِنَ الْبَصْرَةِ: from Basra, the actual place from which hajj was performed
key_terms.مِنَ الْكُوفَةِ: from Kufa, the originally specified place of departure

ai.seo_question: Is a deputized hajj valid if the agent performs it from a different city than the one specified?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about deputized hajj. It indicates that if the representative completes all the rites of hajj, the hajj is valid even if he departed from a place different from the one originally specified.
